svg.title: FlashAttention forward: one block walks over the key tiles
svg.text: FlashAttention forward: one block walks over the key tiles
flash_lib.cu:47–184 at N = 8192, D = 64, BR = BC = 32; the N × N score matrix never exists
one SM: shared memory (28,800 B) + registers

g.text: Block (qt, h, b) owns 32 query rows of one head. Grid (256, 16, 8) = 32,768 such blocks of 256 threads.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
Stage Qi once (lines 81–85): 256 threads copy 32 × 64 floats. Initialise m = −∞, l = 0, o = 0 (lines 88–96).
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
HBM read so far: Q tile 8 KB
Tile j = 0: load Kj and Vj (lines 103–110), between two __syncthreads.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
HBM read: + 8 KB K + 8 KB V
barrier 1: nobody overwrites a tile still being read
barrier 2: nobody reads a half-loaded tile
Scores (lines 118–126): lane c owns key c; S = Qi·Kjᵀ for the warp's 4 rows, kept in REGISTERS (a[4]).
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
a[r] = Σx Qi[row][x] · Kj[c][x] (64 FMAs × 4 rows per lane)
one Kj read feeds 4 FMAs (4 query rows)
Qi read is the same address for all lanes: broadcast
Online softmax (lines 130–152): tile max and sum by 5 shuffles each; p written into S; m, l rescaled.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
m_new = max(m, m_tile); l = e_run·l + e_tile·l_tile
S holds p for THIS tile only (4 KB)
__syncwarp: each warp reads only its own rows of S
PV (lines 158–172): lane x owns features x and x + 32; o = o·e_run + (P·V)·e_tile.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
one Vj read feeds 4 FMAs (4 rows)
Vj[c·64 + x]: adjacent x → adjacent banks, no padding needed
Tile j = 1 overwrites Kj, Vj and S. The old scores are GONE: only m, l, o carry the history.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
tile 0's S was discarded, never written to HBM
HBM read so far: 8 KB + 2 × 16 KB
if the new max is bigger, e_run < 1 shrinks the old l and o
… tile j = 255. Each block has read ALL of its head's K and V once (2 MB + 2 MB), and Q once.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
per block: 8 KB Q + 4 MB K, V read; 0 B of scores written
Finish (lines 175–183): O[row][x] = o / l, written once to HBM. Exact softmax(QKᵀ/√D)·V.
standard path: 34.4 GB at B 8, 16 heads
registers per row: m, l, o
divide by l once, at the very end
measured 160 ms at N = 8192 vs 105 (explicit) and 63 (fused SDPA)
its win is MEMORY, not speed
